comment: Canonical export SQL, shared by the seeder (seed.mjs) and the controller's independent verifier. `tables` is the byte-concatenation order that defines combinedSha256 (spec/seed-spec.md). Each `select` is wrapped as COPY (<select>) TO STDOUT WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true). Timestamps are cast with to_char so the export is ISO-8601 UTC at whole-second precision, byte-identical to the golden CSV.

select.users: SELECT id, display_name, email FROM users ORDER BY id
select.projects: SELECT id, name, description, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM projects ORDER BY id
select.tasks: SELECT id, project_id, assignee_id, title, description, status, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM tasks ORDER BY id
select.comments: SELECT id, task_id, author_id, body, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at FROM comments ORDER BY id
